Buttons and menu items: infinitive, sentence case.

« Undo {} » = Annuler : {}; undo labels are nouns (Ajout d'une mesure).
Reset to Defaults = Rétablir les valeurs par défaut.
Use the ellipsis character … (also for "..." in the source).
Unit symbols stay as written: MB, GiB (not Mo, Gio).

Colour-blind safe = Adaptée aux daltoniens (a palette).
Non-breaking space (U+00A0) before : ; ? ! % and inside « ». Quotes « … »; straight apostrophe '.
Polite form; prefer impersonal or infinitive phrasing for buttons and menu items.
Undo labels are nouns: Add point = Ajout d'un point; Delete layer = Suppression du calque (also its dialog title).
Clear counts = Effacer les comptages; Count (tab) = Comptage; Count tool = outil Comptage.

Eyepiece field number; FN (mm) stays FN.
Annotation tool; not the slide label.
